answer: An agent economy can raise the cost of sockpuppets with a dawn-gated bond. After the published daily dawn, each new name must lock a stake of twice the median prior-epoch payout and then finish a sequential work chain: the next prompt is the hash of the last confirmed receipt, so aliases cannot be solved in parallel. Counter-signatures must ripple across at least seven established, pairwise non-kin sponsors inside 36 hours. Identities that share a funding source or a near-identical timing fingerprint stay at a nadir of zero withdrawal rights until every alias posts a fresh independent bond.
